description: This file defines the CandidateAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It manages the storage and access of file attachments related to candidates, including metadata like filename, file type, size, and content.

classes.name: CandidateAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing candidate file attachments, including properties for file metadata and content, with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate entity associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file, if set.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the binary content of the file.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the binary content of the file.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Returns the attachment type identifier, if set.
